description.zh:
规则模板的创建来源，必填。
- System：系统模板
- UserDefined：用户自定义模板
description.en:
The creation source of the rule template. This parameter is required.
- System: system template
- UserDefined: user-defined template

description.zh: 自定义模板被存放的类目目录，斜线/分隔层级。每个层级名称最长1024个字符，由不能包含空白字符、不能包含反斜线
description.en: The category directory in which the custom template is stored. Levels are separated by forward slashes (/). Each level name can be up to 1,024 characters in length and cannot contain whitespace characters or backslashes.

description.zh: 模板规则名称模糊匹配，如果是系统模板，则会根据语言模糊匹配系统模板的国际化名称
description.en: The fuzzy match of the template rule name. For a system template, the internationalized name of the system template is fuzzy matched based on the language.

description.zh: 列表分页查询页大小，默认为10
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paginated query. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 列表分页查询页码，默认为1
description.en: The page number of a paginated query. Default value: 1.

title.zh: 查询质量规则模版列表
title.en: Queries a list of data quality rule templates

descriptions.zh: 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用
descriptions.en: You must purchase DataWorks Basic Edition or higher to use this feature.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-data-quality-rule-templates --project-id 10000 --creation-source System --directory-path /ods/order_data --name Table_rows --page-number 10 --page-size 1 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListDataQualityRuleTemplates --region cn-hangzhou --DirectoryPath '/ods/order_data' --PageSize 1 --PageNumber 10 --ProjectId 10000 --CreationSource System --Name Table_rows
